headline: BOS @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 3.88 at SEA 3.97, with a projected total of 7.86. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved +0.05 runs while SEA moved -0.40, changing the projected margin by +0.45 runs. The projected total fell -0.34, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Logan Gilbert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ceddanne Rafaela, Josh Naylor, Cole Young, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Connor Joe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
